novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanism/measurement relationship—“an internal ‘factivity gate’” that should transfer truth-presupposition from “know” to the embedded proposition, with failure characterized as a weak or absent verb-to-complement pathway—rather than merely a new setting. The closest prior work is “Language Models Cannot Reliably Distinguish Belief from Knowledge and Fact,” which reports the behavioral failure, and “Navigating the Grey Area: How Expressions of Uncertainty and Overconfidence Affect Language Models” (EMNLP 2023), which studies factive-verb effects behaviorally; searches for “factivity LLM internal representations,” “know believe activation patching,” “factive verb mechanistic interpretability,” and “veridicality circuit language models” did not identify an essentially equivalent circuit-level hypothesis. The step from those works to this claim is a new core relationship—not a direct transfer or simple object substitution—because it predicts a verb-induced change in the internal truth encoding of an identical complement and posits a causal routing mechanism, supporting high but within-framework novelty rather than paradigm-level novelty.
